title: proof_coverage's forty-teeth tooth asks a tester on its own box
intention: proof_coverage's forty-teeth tooth asks the tester's run verb of a bus on its own box, so the tmp fixture path it sends names a file that tester can read.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419, so reach('tester') asked the Dell's tester, which refuses a path on this disk; ['body']['record'] raised KeyError at test_proof_coverage.py:139 and the proof read red.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof a peer leans on reads the same on every box) and RULE 1 (the tester is still asked through its run verb).
how: The tooth asks the run verb from a child (sys.executable <proof> --ask-run <json spec>) under one scratch HOME per proof process (scratch.home_env drops CAIRN_BUS_*); the child's reach lazy-inits a throwaway bus there and prints the reply on its last stdout line; atexit shuts the bus down with RemoteBus(<home>/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/0).shutdown(). The fixture is written to a scratch dir before the ask. d66f2e18fc5c's helper, proof_coverage's own copy.
